sampling: Rank existing UUIDs by HMAC-SHA256 within each stratum; take first three; no replacement/redraw.
frame_eligibility: Complete existing ID chain; registered Fact and publication bounds no later than cutoff; not scientific admission.
human_evidence_admission: G1-G7 unchanged; unknown availability/context cannot be presumed passed.
kappa_formula: 1 - sum(D_ab * O_ab) / sum(D_ab * row_a * col_b / n)
undefined_kappa: NOT_ESTIMABLE; never substitute 1 or treat as passed
unknown_disputed: Retained in status denominator; excluded from numeric subset, never imputed.
missing: Not UNKNOWN and not agreement; primary pilot BLOCKED.
inference_limits: Descriptive 12-item single-case feasibility pilot; dependent evidence/actors; no population CI or p-values.
adjudication: Only after both primary submissions and primary comparison are hashed; no overwrite of primary metrics.
